description.zh: 指定要查询的数据库地址。仅支持精确查询。
description.en: The address of the database that you want to query. Only term query is supported.

description.zh: 要查询的数据库实例名称。
description.en: The name of the database instance that you want to query.

description.zh:
指定要查询的数据库类型，取值：

- **MySQL**
- **Oracle**
- **PostgreSQL**
- **SQLServer**
description.en:
The type of the database that you want to query. Valid values:

- **MySQL**

- **Oracle**

- **PostgreSQL**

- **SQLServer**

description.zh:
堡垒机的实例ID。
> 您可以调用[DescribeInstances](~~153281~~)接口获取该参数。
description.en:
The ID of the Bastionhost instance.

> You can call the [DescribeInstances](~~153281~~) operation to obtain this parameter.
The ID of the network domain.

description.zh: 指定分页查询时，当前页的页码。默认值为1。
description.en: The page number of the paged query. Default value: 1.

description.zh:
指定分页查询时，每页显示的数据最大条数。  
PageSize参数最大取值为100。每页默认显示的数据条数为20条，PageSize参数值为空时，将默认返回20条数据。
> 建议PageSize取值不要为空。
description.en:
The maximum number of entries to return on each page for a paged query.
The maximum value of the PageSize parameter is 100. By default, 20 entries are returned on each page. If you leave the PageSize parameter empty, 20 entries are returned. > We recommend that you do not leave the PageSize parameter empty.

description.zh:
堡垒机的区域ID。
> 区域ID和区域名称的对应关系，请参见[地域和可用区](~~40654~~)。
description.en:
The region ID of the Bastionhost instance.

> For more information about the mapping between region IDs and region names, see [Regions and zones](~~40654~~).

description.zh: 要查询已授权数据库的用户组ID。
description.en: The ID of the user group for which you want to query authorized databases.

title.zh: 查询用户组已授权的数据库列表

example.unifiedCli: aliyun yundun-bastionhost list-databases-for-user-group --instance-id bastionhost-cn-7mz2ve7h00a --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --user-group-id 2 --page-number 1 --page-size 20 --database-name test --database-address 47.101.00.00 --database-type MySQL --network-domain-id 2 --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun yundun-bastionhost ListDatabasesForUserGroup --region cn-hangzhou --PageSize 20 --DatabaseType MySQL --InstanceId 'bastionhost-cn-7mz2ve7h00a' --PageNumber 1 --UserGroupId 2 --DatabaseName test --RegionId 'cn-hangzhou' --DatabaseAddress '47.101.00.00' --NetworkDomainId 2
